geometry_stats.fitted_on: all coordinate training valid nodes only
geometry_stats.statistics_input: cached float32 geometry converted to float64
geometry_stats.neighbor_policy: exclude self/padding; include all kth-distance ties; use all when fewer than k

lr.rule: successful-update warmup then cosine, independent of VAL

checkpoint_rule: strict minimum full VAL macro_vs_sbs_pct with common new81000 TRAIN-fitted SBS; first wins ties
inference_rule: eval mode, fixed physical-node0 TSP slot3 role, original R77 score MLP/pair differences/maximin; stable ascending-global-solver-ID tie break
source_plan: common seed2 full18 natural stream; exact1024 rows, shuffled tails carried across cycles
gradients: micro rows / global1024; one clip/step; AMP overflow replays same batch and RNG
train_eval: full TRAIN every5 VAL points plus the selected best if absent
test: one full TEST after unique VAL-best lock; saved predictions reusable
test_rnd_disclosure: TEST informed earlier R&D; preserved old holdouts plus previously unused input-stratified extensions
nss_reference: reuse exact4500 R84 predictions from locked R79 weights; no NSS inference/retraining

record.tasks: all 18; unchanged full legal pools, no pair-only specialist
record.initialization: identical prepared fresh R77 seed2 parameters and TRAIN geometry statistics; no trained selector initialization
record.model: original R77 complete selector with the same R88 B_execution_anchor TSP input rule in both arms
record.role_selection_reason: known deployment-input completeness, not interim R88 metrics or TEST-based selection
record.objective: unchanged R77: 0.35 native CE + 0.35 comparison + 0.02 relative-gap risk + original ramped R-Drop

A_adamw.optimizer: actual torch.optim.AdamW on the original parameter order

B_muon_hybrid.optimizer: single-device Muon for selected hidden Linear weights, actual AdamW for all auxiliary parameters
B_muon_hybrid.muon_parameter_rule: nn.Linear weight, ndim2 and min(shape)>1, within the named prefixes only
B_muon_hybrid.adamw_parameters: all remaining parameters, including input/condition/geometry/solver mappings, embeddings, normalization, biases and final scalar output
B_muon_hybrid.partition: exhaustive, disjoint, named/shaped runtime receipt; no tensor-layout regrouping
B_muon_hybrid.newton_schulz_precision: BF16 internal matrices; FP32 parameters and momentum
B_muon_hybrid.RMS_boundary: paper-inspired update units, not a claim of exact selector-specific RMS or trajectory matching

record.learning_rate: same successful-update cosine schedule from1e-4 to1e-6 after4320 warmup updates; no LR/WD search
record.gradient_transaction: sum all real logical1024 microbatch gradients, unscale and clip once, then one optimizer step; no per-micro Muon transformation
record.AMP: unchanged FP16 model forward; failed gradient attempts retry the same RNG/batch without advancing optimizer state
record.execution: two already allocated gpu05 4090s after R87 full rc0 delivery, four CPU/nine GiB per arm; no environment upgrade
record.training_engine: immutable R84 loop in an isolated namespace with explicit optimizer constructor injection; shared modules and global torch.optim.AdamW remain unchanged
record.batch_and_task_order: same deterministic natural full18 order and exact logical batches
record.checkpoint_selection: strict minimum full18 VAL macro_vs_sbs_pct using TRAIN-fitted SBS; first exact tie retained
record.formal_evaluation: one VAL-selected checkpoint and fixed inference rule per arm, then complete same-version TEST and both LIBs
record.inference: same full-pool score differences/maximin and execution-role rule; optimizer adds no inference component
record.empirical_screen: B improves VAL macro Top1 with no mean_cost or actual-regret increase versus matched A and historical same-data R84A
record.mechanism_metrics: TRAIN/VAL winner discrimination, fixed R84 target rescues/lost/new false picks, precision, recall and paired cost changes; actual matrix-step diagnostics are not success metrics
record.source_provenance: official single-device Muon primitives pinned by implementation owner plus documented Moonshot RMS scaling; no claim of full LLM-paper reproduction
record.compatibility_boundary: published PyTorch2.5.1/AMP compatibility was unknown; require focused actual CPU checks and a bounded real GPU full18 witness, never silently substitute another optimizer
record.hypothesis_boundary: change update-spectrum geometry without class-frequency weighting; useful weak directions, improved Top1 or cost are not guaranteed
record.declined_option: SD/logit-confidence penalty reviewed but not run; this protocol is optimizer-only

input_roles.reason: known execution protocol; not selected from R88 interim or TEST results
